general-physician.headline: Care for the whole family, from fevers to yearly checkups.

reviews.q: Dr. sahib took time to explain my father's BP reports properly. We've been coming here for two years now.
Booked an evening slot on WhatsApp and was seen within fifteen minutes of arriving.
The full body checkup was well organised, and the follow-up call about my results was a nice touch.

dermatology.headline: Healthy skin and hair, treated by a dermatologist.

reviews.q: My acne marks have faded a lot after four peel sessions. The doctor set honest expectations from day one.
Finally a clinic that treated my hair fall properly instead of just selling me shampoo.
Clean clinic, female staff for laser sessions, and they always run on time.

dental.headline: Gentle dental care for a smile you're happy to show.

reviews.q: I was scared of root canals, but it felt like a normal filling. No pain at all afterwards.
My daughter's braces were explained step by step, with clear costs before we started.
Quick scaling and polishing in my lunch break. The dentist was very gentle with my sensitive gums.

gynecology.headline: Women's health and pregnancy care with a doctor you trust.

reviews.q: She looked after me through my whole pregnancy and the delivery. I always felt listened to.
After years of irregular periods, I finally have a PCOS plan that's working.
Female doctor, female staff, and a private waiting area. Exactly what I was looking for.

pediatrics.headline: Caring for your child from the first vaccine to the teen years.

reviews.q: Our son had a high fever at night. We got a morning slot and the doctor was so calm with him.
They send a WhatsApp reminder before every vaccine, so we've never missed one.
The play corner keeps the kids busy, and the doctor never rushes us.
Three other doctors told me I needed knee surgery. Here they tried physio and injections first, and it worked.
My son's fracture was set quickly and the follow-ups were well planned.
Clear explanation of my MRI and a realistic recovery plan for my back.

ent.headline: Ear, nose and throat care for adults and children.

reviews.q: My sinus problem of five years is finally under control after the nasal endoscopy.
They removed the ear wax safely in minutes. I could hear properly again straight away.
The doctor was patient with my daughter before her tonsil surgery and everything went smoothly.

eye-care.headline: Clear vision and healthy eyes for every age.

reviews.q: My mother's cataract surgery took less than half an hour, and she was reading again the next week.
Thorough eye test for my kids, with no pressure to buy expensive frames.
They checked whether LASIK was right for me before anything else. I'm glasses-free now.

cardiology.headline: Expert heart care, close to home.

reviews.q: ECG and echo done the same day, with the results explained right there. Very reassuring.
My father's BP had been high for years. It's been stable for six months now.
The doctor explained my angiography report in simple Urdu. I understood my options.
After eight sessions my back pain from desk work is mostly gone, and I know which exercises to keep doing.
Home sessions for my mother after her knee replacement made a huge difference.
Got back to cricket after a shoulder injury in six weeks.

nutrition.headline: A diet plan that fits your life and your food.

reviews.q: Lost 9 kg in four months without giving up roti. The plan felt realistic.
My PCOS symptoms improved once I followed her plan. The weekly WhatsApp check-ins kept me going.
She planned meals my whole family could eat, which made it easy to stick to.

psychiatry.headline: Talk to someone who understands, in confidence.

reviews.q: I was nervous about my first visit, but the doctor made me feel completely at ease.
Online sessions meant I could get help without anyone at home knowing. That mattered to me.
My sleep has improved and I feel like myself again after three months.

diabetes-endocrinology.clinic: Sugar Care Diabetes and Thyroid Centre
diabetes-endocrinology.headline: Keep your sugar and thyroid under control.

reviews.q: My HbA1c came down from 9.2 to 6.8 in six months with their plan.
They trained me to use insulin at home step by step. I'm no longer scared of it.
My thyroid was finally diagnosed properly after years of feeling tired.

gastroenterology.clinic: Gut Health Gastro and Liver Clinic
gastroenterology.headline: Relief for stomach, liver and digestive problems.

reviews.q: Years of acidity, finally diagnosed as H. pylori and treated in two weeks.
The endoscopy was quick and painless with sedation. I went home within two hours.
My hepatitis C was cured with tablets in three months. Thank you, doctor sahib.

urology.headline: Kidney stone and urinary care, done right.

reviews.q: My kidney stone was removed with laser and I went home the same day.
The doctor explained my father's prostate options clearly, without rushing into surgery.
Recurring UTIs finally sorted after the right tests. Very professional clinic.

neurology.headline: Specialist care for headaches, fits, stroke and nerves.

reviews.q: My migraines went from twice a week to twice a month with the prevention plan.
My son's epilepsy is well controlled now. The doctor is always reachable for questions.
After my father's stroke, the follow-up and rehab plan helped him walk again.
